source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Use the AMD RAS tool under Linux to enumerate PCIe slot BDFs, inject `errortype 0` correctable LCRC at an end device and a root port, and verify tool PASS plus an OS report within timeout.
procedure_facts: Verify the recipe and establish a log boundary.
Apply six NBIO/AMD PBS/FCH settings, including AER and SyncFlood controls.
Unlock via HDT and boot Ubuntu 20.04 or the ambiguous `RHEL 2022` label.
Run one fixed example end-device BDF and one fixed example root-port BDF with `--einjbiopcie ... --errortype 0`.
criteria_facts: The correctable injection tool reports PASS.
The OS reports the error within a defined timeout.
dmesg and the injection report match the AMD RAS specification.
The note says EINJ correctable injection is completed by an LCRC at the root port or end device.
source_conflicts: The procedure supplies both end-device and root-port injections, while the acceptance note says root port or end device; required loci per slot are not defined.
The source labels one supported environment `RHEL 2022`, which is not a precise RHEL release identifier.
missing_source_information: N and the complete physical-slot/end-device/upstream-root-port BDF matrix.
Whether each slot requires endpoint, root port or both injection loci.
Exact supported RHEL release/kernel if RHEL is selected.
Tool build, timeout, expected AER fields/counters and restoration policy.
Whether the private script link is the authoritative implementation and its immutable revision/hash.

original_test_intent.statement: Validate AMD PCIe correctable LCRC handling for every required PCIe slot using approved BDF targets, with successful tool completion, timely Linux AER reporting and unchanged device/link/platform health.
must_preserve: AMD correctable PCIe error, `errortype 0` and LCRC behavior.
PCIe slots 1~N, not one example slot.
The source's endpoint and root-port operations without assuming whether both are mandatory until resolved.
Tool PASS and OS report within timeout as independent gates.
must_not_infer: That segment 0 buses 65/64 and device/function values apply beyond the source example platform.
That root-port and endpoint BDFs can be derived by subtracting one bus number.
That both or only one locus is required without owner clarification.
That a correctable result permits SyncFlood, reset or link degradation.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly keeps a gated hybrid, treats the shown BDFs as requiring enumeration/validation, distinguishes endpoint and root port, and requires recovery.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 unconditionally requires both loci without exposing the procedure-versus-note conflict, does not make per-slot 1~N iteration explicit, and does not resolve the ambiguous RHEL release or authoritative private script revision.

related_records: Same-title Intel and AMD non-fatal/fatal/LCRC/ECRC/ACS/poisoned-TLP cases are separate variants.
applicable_history.precedence_application: Only Reliability row 55 controls this AMD correctable `errortype 0` case; adjacent recipes cannot resolve its target-locus ambiguity.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep the gated hybrid capability, but require a signed per-slot matrix that explicitly selects endpoint, root port or both loci, validates every BDF after enumeration, identifies the exact Linux release and defines correctable AER evidence and recovery before injection.

conditions_present: The correctable LCRC intent, enumeration command, injection API shape, Linux evidence family and high-level PASS/timeout criteria are known.
missing: Complete slot/path matrix; locus policy; exact OS/kernel; tool/script version/hash; expected AER record/counters and timeout; device traffic/health, approval and restoration rules.
provider: Test owner resolves both-versus-either locus and exact OS release.
Platform owner supplies physical slot/device/root-port mapping and acceptable device workload.
AMD/ODM FAE supplies the signed tool, correctable LCRC evidence and recovery recipe.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory each slot/device/serial/BDF/link/driver and upstream bridge ancestry.
Run approved non-mutating BDF enumeration and reconcile it with physical labels.
Export dmesg/journal, AER counters, rasdaemon/BMC/firmware baselines and read current BIOS values without clearing or changing them.
prohibited_until_resolved: BIOS changes, HDT unlock, log clear, endpoint/root-port injection, device reset, link manipulation, retry or restoration.
closure_evidence: Signed matrix states required locus or loci for every slot and reconciles fresh enumeration.
Exact OS/kernel and tool/script revision/hash are approved.
Expected correctable LCRC record/counter, timeout, health gate, authorization and final-state plan are signed.

revision_candidate.test_name: AMD PCIe Correctable LCRC Injection Across Slots 1~N
revision_candidate.purpose: For every required PCIe slot, inject the approved correctable LCRC at each owner-required endpoint and/or root-port locus and verify correct target attribution, tool PASS, timely Linux AER evidence and preserved device/link/platform health.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Only the AMD server, BIOS/BMC/firmware, exact Ubuntu 20.04 or owner-specified RHEL release/kernel, PCIe devices/drivers, HDT method and AMD RAS tool/script revision covered by the signed recipe.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every populated and explicitly required PCIe slot 1~N in the signed matrix. Each row binds physical label, endpoint identity/serial/BDF and upstream root-port BDF and states endpoint, root port or both as required loci. Test each locus separately. Exclude OCP-only, Intel, non-fatal, fatal, ECRC, ACS and poisoned-TLP variants. Treat 30/60 minutes as estimates.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: N and signed slot/path/locus matrix; fresh `--listpcieslotsbdfinfo`; device idle/test-traffic policy; exact tool and private-script revision/hash; `errortype 0`/LCRC semantics; six BIOS values and restore plan; exact Linux/kernel; expected dmesg/journal/AER/rasdaemon fields and counter deltas; timeout; go/no-go, approval and recovery.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Preserve and hash Linux, AER, BMC and firmware baselines before any approved clear or establish a timestamp marker. A qualified operator applies the six approved BIOS settings and HDT unlock. Boot the signed Linux build, enumerate all slot BDFs and reconcile each endpoint/upstream path. For each slot and each required locus, create a unique full log, verify identity/link/traffic, run one exact `--einjbiopcie --segment <s> --bus <b> --device <d> --function <f> --errortype 0`, collect tool and native AER evidence within timeout, and confirm link/device health before the next go/no-go. Restore BIOS/HDT/tool state after all approved loci.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Locus conflict and OS label resolved; exact slot/BDF matrix and package approved; dedicated non-production SUT; expected correctable/no-reset behavior defined; device workload quiesced or recipe-controlled; baselines, clocks/storage, console/OOB and recovery proven; every BIOS, HDT, clear, injection, recovery and restoration action approved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Platform/OS/kernel/tool/script identity and hashes; signed slot/path/locus matrix; fresh enumeration; device/driver/link/function before and after; BIOS/HDT before/during/after; baseline/clear audit; exact per-locus command and full tool report with PASS; timestamped Linux AER/LCRC record and expected counter delta tied to the target BDF within timeout; rasdaemon/BMC/firmware evidence when required; anomalies, recovery and restored-final-state proof.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The signed AMD/ODM correctable LCRC recipe plus owner-resolved per-slot locus matrix. Each required locus independently needs tool PASS, target-correlated Linux evidence within timeout and unchanged or recipe-defined healthy link/device/system state.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: High-risk PCIe injection on a dedicated SUT only. Do not copy example BDFs, infer topology arithmetically, select an unapproved locus, reuse another fault type, target production/boot/management-critical devices, expose secrets, truncate evidence, auto-loop, trigger or accept unexpected SyncFlood/reset, retry or continue after wrong target, link/device degradation, error storm or instability.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Test owner approves the locus policy and OS; platform owner approves every physical/path row and device impact; AMD/ODM FAE approves tool, LCRC behavior and target. Qualified operator applies BIOS/HDT and handles recovery. Each locus injection, next-target go/no-go and final restoration require signed authorization.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Qualified staff own BIOS/HDT, physical slot confirmation and exceptional recovery. After exact handoff, an authorized Agent may perform fresh enumeration, execute each bounded approved tool command and correlate evidence; engineering decides anomaly and final PASS/FAIL status.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On wrong BDF/locus, tool failure, absent/late AER record, unexpected uncorrectable/fatal severity, SyncFlood/reset, link/device loss or persistent counter/error state, stop the matrix, preserve evidence and use only the signed per-device/platform recovery. Restore BIOS/HDT/tool state and prove final link/device/system health before any separately approved rerun.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unresolved locus/OS or mapping; enumeration mismatch; tool/script/BIOS/HDT mismatch; missing approval, baseline, timeout, health policy, recovery or evidence; wrong BDF/fault/severity; missing tool PASS or timely target-correlated AER record; unexpected reset/SyncFlood, link retrain/downshift/loss, device/function degradation, error storm or thermal/power instability; or failed recovery/restoration/final health.

identified_defects: The procedure requires endpoint and root-port commands while the criteria say root port or endpoint; V2 silently chooses both.
V2 does not explicitly repeat the selected locus/loci for every slot 1~N.
The source BDFs are fixed examples, not a complete slot matrix.
The RHEL release label is ambiguous and the private script revision was not available for audit.
V2 does not explicitly make unexpected SyncFlood/reset a failure of this correctable case.
reason_for_change: Preserve full slot coverage without inventing endpoint/root-port scope, prevent example-BDF reuse and make correctable no-reset health behavior auditable.

new_technical_evidence.title: Linux Kernel: PCI Express Advanced Error Reporting Driver Guide HOWTO
new_technical_evidence.applicability: The source selects Linux and requires dmesg/AER evidence
new_technical_evidence.supports: PCIe correctable errors are hardware-corrected, logged by AER and do not require recovery action; uncorrectable errors have different non-fatal/fatal handling. Unexpected reset or link loss is therefore not normal evidence for this correctable case.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Exact LCRC record fields, counters and firmware-versus-OS AER ownership remain platform/kernel-specific.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-System RAS-00775-V003
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Only the AMD PCIe correctable slot row
new_technical_evidence.supports: The six BIOS settings, enumeration, endpoint/root-port commands, errortype 0, LCRC note and PASS/timeout gates.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Both-versus-either locus, N, full BDF map, RHEL release and timeout are unresolved.

removed_ambiguities: Requires owner resolution of endpoint, root port or both per slot.
Turns examples into a freshly enumerated signed slot/path matrix.
Requires exact Linux/kernel and tool/script revision.
Treats unexpected SyncFlood/reset or device/link degradation as a stop for the correctable case and excludes adjacent fault variants.
resolved_blockers: Package, mapping and approval dependencies remain provider-closable; capability stays REQUIRES rather than BLOCKED.
remaining_blockers: Execution awaits locus-policy resolution, complete slot/BDF matrix, exact OS/tool/script, expected AER/timeout, authorization and recovery.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 exposes the endpoint-versus-root-port conflict, makes every slot/locus auditable, prevents copied BDF targeting and adds a source-specific correctable no-reset health gate.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Contract-only validation recovered every signed slot/locus entry, exact endpoint and upstream BDF separation, verified errortype-0/LCRC semantics, Linux target-correlated AER/counter evidence and correctable no-reset health gates. It rejected example/stale BDFs, representative coverage, automatic looping and tool-only completion.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Reliability row 55 enumerates AMD PCIe paths, uses errortype 0 LCRC at endpoint/root port and requires tool PASS plus timely Linux reporting.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 correctly validates BDFs and retains REQUIRES, but assumes both loci, underdefines 1~N iteration and does not gate unexpected reset.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Allow read-only inventory/enumeration/baseline work; forbid BIOS/HDT/injection until per-slot loci, fresh BDFs and evidence/recovery rules are signed.
